Gunko knows the Soul King?! l ONE PIECE l Episode 1177
How does Gunko know Brook is the Soul King? 💀🎸

For Brook, the second chance at life given to him by Captain Straw Hat Luffy, means more than anything - and he’d rather die with his honor and loyalty intact than live without them. ☠️
